title: Beatrix and the Aftermath
author: Felix Eriksen
blurb: Vesper Crane, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
